payload.core_mechanism_summary: Selection sort adapted to allowed operation: for each position, find minimum in remainder, then cyclically shift subarray left to bring minimum to front.
payload.rationale: Code iteratively finds minimum element in unsorted suffix and rotates subarray to move it to correct position, implementing a selection sort using cyclic shifts. No custom key or comparator; but among limited candidates, sorting_custom_key is the only applicable sorting subtype.
